refs.prep: Each row is one sample and one BAM, so no subset, split or concatenation is needed. Element identifiers are the samplesheet sample_id values (test, test2, test3). test and test2 exercise the paired branch; test3 is single-end and exercises the single branch. Not carried: the default candidate's index column (bai files for test and test2; dropped entry user-index-column-not-carried), the CRAM candidate's rows (CRAM not carried), and the genome.fasta that every candidate declares (the v1 workflow has no reference input; decision reference-dropped-with-cram). Open: no index is staged for any element, so the samtools_idxstats step depends on the wrapper indexing internally (untested; phase 12).
